examples.en: The smell of fresh bread always tempts me to buy a loaf.
examples.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味總是讓我忍不住想買一條。

examples.en: Don't let a low price tempt you into buying something you don't need.
examples.zh: 別讓低價誘使你買下不需要的東西。

examples.en: The sunny weather tempted us to skip class and go to the beach.
examples.zh: 晴朗的天氣讓我們想翹課去海邊。

examples.en: I couldn't resist the temptation to check my phone during the movie.
examples.zh: 看電影時，我抵擋不住誘惑，查看了手機。

examples.en: A box of chocolates on the desk is a big temptation for me.
examples.zh: 桌上的一盒巧克力對我來說是很大的誘惑。

examples.en: He gave in to temptation and ate the last piece of cake.
examples.zh: 他抵擋不住誘惑，吃掉了最後一塊蛋糕。

examples.en: The witness will testify in court on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 這位證人星期一早上會出庭作證。

examples.en: Several neighbors testified that they had seen him at home that night.
examples.zh: 幾位鄰居作證說，他們那晚看到他在家。

examples.en: Her success testifies to years of hard work.
examples.zh: 她的成功證明了多年的努力。

examples.en: This sweater has a soft texture that feels nice on the skin.
examples.zh: 這件毛衣質地柔軟，穿在身上很舒服。

examples.en: I like the creamy texture of this ice cream.
examples.zh: 我喜歡這種冰淇淋綿密的口感。

examples.en: The artist used paint to give the wall a rough texture.
examples.zh: 藝術家用顏料讓牆面呈現粗糙的質感。

examples.en: The class focuses on theoretical knowledge rather than practical skills.
examples.zh: 這堂課著重理論知識，而不是實務技能。

examples.en: There is a theoretical chance that the plan could work.
examples.zh: 這個計畫理論上有可能成功。

examples.en: He has a strong theoretical background in physics.
examples.zh: 他在物理方面有深厚的理論基礎。

examples.en: My sister works as a physical therapist at a local hospital.
examples.zh: 我姊姊在當地醫院擔任物理治療師。

examples.en: She talks to a therapist once a week to manage stress.
examples.zh: 她每週找心理治療師談一次話來紓解壓力。

examples.en: The therapist taught him some exercises for his sore back.
examples.zh: 治療師教了他一些緩解背痛的運動。

examples.en: She saved money every month, thereby paying off her debt early.
examples.zh: 她每個月都存錢，因而提早還清了債務。

examples.en: The company cut its costs, thereby increasing its profits.
examples.zh: 公司降低成本，藉此提高了利潤。

examples.en: He practiced often, thereby improving his English speaking skills.
examples.zh: 他經常練習，因而提升了英語口說能力。

examples.en: She is writing her master's thesis on climate change.
examples.zh: 她正在寫關於氣候變遷的碩士論文。

examples.en: The professor asked him to defend his thesis in front of the committee.
examples.zh: 教授要求他在委員會面前為論文答辯。

examples.en: The main thesis of the article is that sleep improves memory.
examples.zh: 這篇文章的主要論點是睡眠能增進記憶力。

examples.en: He hurt his thigh while playing basketball.
examples.zh: 他打籃球時傷到了大腿。

examples.en: Squats are a good exercise for strengthening your thighs.
examples.zh: 深蹲是強化大腿的好運動。

examples.en: The baby sat on her mother's thigh and laughed.
examples.zh: 小嬰兒坐在媽媽的大腿上笑著。

examples.en: The little girl stood at the threshold and waved goodbye.
examples.zh: 小女孩站在門口揮手道別。

examples.en: You must earn above a certain threshold to apply for this program.
examples.zh: 你的收入必須超過一定門檻才能申請這個計畫。

examples.en: The company is on the threshold of a major change.
examples.zh: 這家公司正處於重大轉變的臨界點。

examples.en: Riding the roller coaster gave the kids a big thrill.
examples.zh: 搭雲霄飛車讓孩子們感到非常興奮。

examples.en: She felt a thrill when she heard her name called.
examples.zh: 聽到自己的名字被叫到時，她感到一陣興奮。

examples.en: For many travelers, the thrill of discovering a new place is worth the trip.
examples.zh: 對許多旅客來說，探索新地方的刺激感值得這趟旅程。

examples.en: The magic show thrilled the young audience.
examples.zh: 魔術表演讓年輕的觀眾非常興奮。

examples.en: The news of the victory thrilled the whole school.
examples.zh: 勝利的消息讓全校都很激動。

examples.en: It thrills me to see my students make progress.
examples.zh: 看到學生進步讓我很興奮。

examples.en: We watched a thriller on Friday night and couldn't sleep.
examples.zh: 我們星期五晚上看了一部驚悚片，結果睡不著。

examples.en: This thriller is so exciting that I finished it in one day.
examples.zh: 這本懸疑小說太精采，我一天就看完了。

examples.en: She enjoys reading a good thriller on long flights.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在長途飛行時閱讀一本好看的懸疑小說。

examples.en: These plants thrive in warm and sunny places.
examples.zh: 這些植物在溫暖又向陽的地方長得很好。

examples.en: Small businesses can thrive when the community supports them.
examples.zh: 當社區支持時，小型商店也能蓬勃發展。

examples.en: Many children thrive when they receive enough love and attention.
examples.zh: 許多孩子在得到足夠的關愛與關注時會健康成長。

examples.en: The king sat on his golden throne and spoke to the crowd.
examples.zh: 國王坐在金色的寶座上對群眾說話。

examples.en: The young prince will take the throne next year.
examples.zh: 年輕的王子明年將登上王位。

examples.en: Visitors can see the royal throne in the museum.
examples.zh: 遊客可以在博物館裡看到皇家寶座。

examples.en: She thrust the letter into my hand and hurried away.
examples.zh: 她把信塞進我手裡就匆匆離開了。

examples.en: The boy thrust his hands into his pockets because it was cold.
examples.zh: 天氣很冷，男孩把雙手插進口袋裡。

examples.en: He thrust the door open and ran into the classroom.
examples.zh: 他用力推開門，跑進了教室。

examples.en: The thrust of the engine pushes the plane forward.
examples.zh: 引擎的推力讓飛機向前飛行。

examples.en: The main thrust of her speech was about saving energy.
examples.zh: 她演講的主旨是關於節約能源。

examples.en: The rocket needs enough thrust to leave the ground.
examples.zh: 火箭需要足夠的推力才能離開地面。

examples.en: I could hear the tick of the clock in the quiet room.
examples.zh: 在安靜的房間裡，我聽得到時鐘的滴答聲。

examples.en: Please put a tick next to each task you have finished.
examples.zh: 請在你完成的每件事旁打勾。

examples.en: The vet found a tick on the dog's ear.
examples.zh: 獸醫在狗的耳朵上發現了一隻壁蝨。

examples.en: The old clock on the wall ticks loudly all night.
examples.zh: 牆上的老時鐘整晚都滴答作響。

examples.en: Tick the box if you agree with the rules.
examples.zh: 如果你同意這些規定，請在方框內打勾。

examples.en: The teacher ticked each correct answer on my test.
examples.zh: 老師在我考卷上每個正確的答案都打了勾。

examples.en: We chose white tiles for the bathroom floor.
examples.zh: 我們為浴室地板選了白色磁磚。

examples.en: One tile on the kitchen wall is cracked.
examples.zh: 廚房牆上有一片磁磚裂開了。

examples.en: The roof is covered with red tiles.
examples.zh: 屋頂鋪滿了紅色的瓦片。

examples.en: They plan to tile the kitchen floor this weekend.
examples.zh: 他們打算這個週末在廚房地板鋪磁磚。

examples.en: My uncle tiled the whole bathroom by himself.
examples.zh: 我叔叔自己一個人把整間浴室都鋪好了磁磚。

examples.en: It took two days to tile the small entrance.
examples.zh: 鋪好這個小玄關的磁磚花了兩天。

examples.en: Drivers must pay a toll to use this bridge.
examples.zh: 駕駛人必須支付通行費才能使用這座橋。

examples.en: Working late every night has taken a toll on his health.
examples.zh: 每天加班到很晚，對他的健康造成了損害。

examples.en: The storm's death toll rose to ten by Sunday.
examples.zh: 到星期日為止，這場暴風雨的死亡人數增加到十人。

examples.en: The church bell tolls every hour.
examples.zh: 教堂的鐘每小時都會敲響。

examples.en: The school bell tolled to mark the end of class.
examples.zh: 學校的鐘聲響起，表示下課了。

examples.en: Old bells toll slowly across the quiet town.
examples.zh: 古老的鐘聲緩緩穿過寧靜的小鎮。

examples.en: The noise from the construction site tormented the neighbors.
examples.zh: 工地的噪音折磨著鄰居們。

examples.en: Guilt tormented her after she broke her friend's trust.
examples.zh: 她辜負朋友的信任後，內疚感一直折磨著她。

examples.en: Stop tormenting your little brother with silly jokes.
examples.zh: 別再用無聊的玩笑煩你弟弟了。

examples.en: Waiting for the test results was pure torment.
examples.zh: 等待考試結果簡直是一種折磨。

examples.en: He lived in torment after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故之後，他一直活在痛苦中。

examples.en: The long meeting was a torment for everyone.
examples.zh: 這場冗長的會議對每個人來說都是折磨。

examples.en: Our school team won the basketball tournament last month.
examples.zh: 我們學校的隊伍上個月贏得了籃球錦標賽。

examples.en: The tennis tournament will begin next Saturday.
examples.zh: 網球錦標賽將在下週六開始。

examples.en: She traveled to Japan for a chess tournament.
examples.zh: 她前往日本參加西洋棋比賽。

examples.en: Some cleaning products are toxic if you swallow them.
examples.zh: 有些清潔用品如果吞下去是有毒的。

examples.en: The factory was fined for releasing toxic waste into the river.
examples.zh: 這家工廠因把有毒廢棄物排入河中而被罰款。

examples.en: A toxic work environment can harm your mental health.
examples.zh: 有害的職場環境可能傷害你的心理健康。

examples.en: Honesty is the most important trait in a good friend.
examples.zh: 誠實是好朋友最重要的特質。

examples.en: She has inherited her mother's curly hair and other family traits.
examples.zh: 她遺傳了媽媽的捲髮和其他家族特徵。

examples.en: Patience is a useful trait for a teacher.
examples.zh: 耐心對老師來說是很有用的特質。

examples.en: The team called him a traitor when he joined their rival.
examples.zh: 他加入對手隊伍時，隊友稱他為叛徒。

examples.en: In the story, the traitor shared the secret with the enemy.
examples.zh: 故事中，叛徒把秘密告訴了敵人。

examples.en: Nobody wanted to be friends with the traitor after that.
examples.zh: 那之後沒有人想跟那個叛徒當朋友。

examples.en: The bank will record every transaction on your account.
examples.zh: 銀行會記錄你帳戶的每一筆交易。

examples.en: The online transaction was completed in less than a minute.
examples.zh: 這筆線上交易不到一分鐘就完成了。

examples.en: Please keep the receipt as proof of the transaction.
examples.zh: 請保留收據作為交易的證明。

examples.en: The old factory went through a complete transformation into a museum.
examples.zh: 那間舊工廠徹底轉型成了博物館。

examples.en: Her transformation from a shy girl to a confident speaker surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 她從害羞的女孩變成自信的演說者，讓大家都很驚訝。

examples.en: Digital technology has caused a major transformation in education.
examples.zh: 數位科技為教育帶來了重大的轉變。

examples.en: Many people use public transit to get to work.
examples.zh: 許多人搭乘大眾運輸工具上班。

examples.en: The package was damaged in transit.
examples.zh: 這個包裹在運送途中受損了。

examples.en: We were in transit in Tokyo before flying home.
examples.zh: 我們飛回家前，曾在東京過境轉機。

examples.en: Moving to a new school can be a difficult transition for children.
examples.zh: 轉到新學校對孩子來說可能是個困難的轉變。

examples.en: The company is making a smooth transition to online sales.
examples.zh: 這家公司正順利地轉型為線上銷售。

examples.en: The transition from summer to autumn is my favorite time of year.
examples.zh: 從夏天轉入秋天的過渡期是我最喜歡的時節。

examples.en: She transitioned from teaching to office work last year.
examples.zh: 她去年從教學工作轉為辦公室工作。

examples.en: The class will transition to online lessons next week.
examples.zh: 這個班級下週將轉為線上授課。

examples.en: Our team is transitioning to a new software system.
examples.zh: 我們的團隊正在轉換到新的軟體系統。

examples.en: The storm interrupted the television transmission last night.
examples.zh: 暴風雨讓昨晚的電視訊號傳送中斷了。

examples.en: Washing hands helps stop the transmission of germs.
examples.zh: 洗手有助於阻止細菌傳播。

examples.en: The mechanic said the car needs a new transmission.
examples.zh: 技師說這輛車需要換新的變速箱。

senses.zh: 透明的；公開透明的；容易識破的

examples.en: The box is made of transparent plastic, so you can see inside.
examples.zh: 這個盒子是用透明塑膠做的，所以看得到裡面。

examples.en: The school wants to be transparent about how it spends money.
examples.zh: 學校希望在經費使用上做到公開透明。

examples.en: Her excuse was so transparent that nobody believed her.
examples.zh: 她的藉口太明顯了，沒有人相信她。

examples.en: The emergency doctor treated a patient with severe chest trauma.
examples.zh: 急診醫師治療了一名胸部嚴重外傷的病人。

examples.en: Counselors work with students who have emotional trauma.
examples.zh: 輔導老師會協助有情緒創傷的學生。

examples.en: The trauma of losing his home stayed with him for years.
examples.zh: 失去家園的創傷在他心裡留了好幾年。

examples.en: The concert was a tribute to the singer's long career.
examples.zh: 這場演唱會是向這位歌手的漫長生涯致敬。

examples.en: Students wrote letters as a tribute to their retiring teacher.
examples.zh: 學生們寫信向即將退休的老師表達敬意。

examples.en: The small kingdom sent gold as tribute to the emperor.
examples.zh: 這個小王國向皇帝進貢黃金。

examples.en: Dust can trigger allergies in some people.
examples.zh: 灰塵可能會引發某些人的過敏。

examples.en: A small mistake triggered a long argument between the two friends.
examples.zh: 一個小失誤引發了兩位朋友之間的一場長時間爭吵。

examples.en: Any movement near the door will trigger the alarm.
examples.zh: 任何靠近門的動作都會觸發警報。

examples.en: Stress is a common trigger for headaches.
examples.zh: 壓力是頭痛的常見誘因。

examples.en: Loud noise is a trigger for the baby's crying.
examples.zh: 大聲響是這個嬰兒哭鬧的誘因。

examples.en: The museum guide pointed to the trigger on the antique rifle.
examples.zh: 博物館導覽員指著古董步槍上的扳機。

examples.en: My father trims the hedge in the garden every month.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每個月都會修剪花園裡的樹籬。

examples.en: I need to trim my bangs before the interview.
examples.zh: 面試前我得修剪一下瀏海。

examples.en: The company plans to trim its costs by ten percent.
examples.zh: 公司計畫把成本削減百分之十。

examples.en: She kept her garden neat and trim all year.
examples.zh: 她整年都把花園維持得整齊俐落。

examples.en: He stays trim by jogging every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上慢跑，所以保持著勻稱的身材。

examples.en: The soldier wore a trim uniform to the ceremony.
examples.zh: 那位軍人穿著合身整齊的制服參加典禮。

examples.en: The store offers triple points on every purchase this week.
examples.zh: 這家店本週所有購物都提供三倍點數。

examples.en: The athlete won a triple jump gold medal.
examples.zh: 那位選手贏得了三級跳遠的金牌。

examples.en: She ordered a triple scoop of ice cream.
examples.zh: 她點了三球的冰淇淋。

examples.en: The price of the ticket has tripled since last year.
examples.zh: 這張票的價格比去年漲了兩倍。

examples.en: The company hopes to triple its sales in five years.
examples.zh: 公司希望五年內讓銷售額成長為三倍。

examples.en: Rent in the city has nearly tripled in ten years.
examples.zh: 這個城市的房租在十年內幾乎漲成了三倍。

examples.en: Don't waste time arguing about trivial matters.
examples.zh: 別浪費時間爭論瑣碎的小事。

examples.en: The difference in price is trivial, so buy the better one.
examples.zh: 價格差異微不足道，所以買比較好的那個吧。

examples.en: He apologized for the trivial mistake in the report.
examples.zh: 他為報告中那個小錯誤道了歉。

examples.en: Our class proudly held the trophy after the sports day.
examples.zh: 運動會結束後，我們班驕傲地捧著獎盃。

examples.en: The trophy is on display in the school hall.
examples.zh: 獎盃陳列在學校的穿堂。

examples.en: She placed her first trophy on the shelf next to her books.
examples.zh: 她把第一座獎盃擺在書旁邊的架子上。

examples.en: The university raised its tuition again this year.
examples.zh: 這所大學今年又調漲了學費。

examples.en: She works part-time to pay her tuition.
examples.zh: 她打工來支付學費。

examples.en: Private tuition in math helped him pass the exam.
examples.zh: 數學的私人補習幫助他通過了考試。

examples.en: The doctor found a small tumor in his stomach.
examples.zh: 醫生在他的胃裡發現了一顆小腫瘤。

examples.en: The tests showed that the tumor was benign and growing slowly.
examples.zh: 檢查顯示這顆腫瘤是良性的，而且生長緩慢。

examples.en: She had surgery to remove the tumor last spring.
examples.zh: 她去年春天動了手術切除腫瘤。

examples.en: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐做了一份鮪魚三明治。

examples.en: Fresh tuna is popular in many Japanese restaurants.
examples.zh: 新鮮的鮪魚在許多日本餐廳很受歡迎。

examples.en: The fishermen caught a huge tuna near the coast.
examples.zh: 漁夫在海岸附近捕到了一條巨大的鮪魚。

examples.en: Winning the championship is their ultimate goal.
examples.zh: 贏得冠軍是他們的最終目標。

examples.en: This hotel offers the ultimate luxury experience.
examples.zh: 這間飯店提供極致奢華的體驗。

examples.en: The ultimate decision belongs to the manager.
examples.zh: 最後的決定權在經理手上。

examples.en: The reporter uncovered a serious problem at the factory.
examples.zh: 記者揭露了這間工廠的一個嚴重問題。

examples.en: Scientists uncovered an ancient village under the sand.
examples.zh: 科學家在沙地下發現了一座古老的村落。

examples.en: She uncovered the pot and stirred the soup.
examples.zh: 她掀開鍋蓋攪拌了湯。

examples.en: My grandfather will undergo surgery next week.
examples.zh: 我爺爺下週要接受手術。

examples.en: The old bridge underwent major repairs this year.
examples.zh: 這座老橋今年進行了大規模整修。

examples.en: All new employees must undergo training in their first month.
examples.zh: 所有新進員工在第一個月都必須接受訓練。

examples.en: She is an undergraduate majoring in biology.
examples.zh: 她是主修生物的大學生。

examples.en: Undergraduates can borrow up to ten books from the library.
examples.zh: 大學部學生最多可以向圖書館借十本書。

examples.en: My brother was an undergraduate at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我哥哥以前是台北一所大學的大學生。

examples.en: He took an undergraduate course in economics.
examples.zh: 他修了一門大學部的經濟學課程。

examples.en: Undergraduate students must finish this class before graduation.
examples.zh: 大學部學生畢業前必須修完這門課。

examples.en: She received an undergraduate degree in English.
examples.zh: 她取得了英文學士學位。

examples.en: Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence.
examples.zh: 不斷的批評可能會逐漸削弱孩子的自信。

examples.en: Rumors about the manager undermined the team's trust in her.
examples.zh: 關於經理的謠言削弱了團隊對她的信任。

examples.en: Staying up late will undermine your efforts to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 熬夜會破壞你維持健康的努力。

examples.en: Can you help me undo this knot in my shoelace?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我解開鞋帶上的這個結嗎？

examples.en: Press this button to undo your last change.
examples.zh: 按下這個按鈕就能撤銷你的上一個更動。

examples.en: Nothing can undo the harm that the rumor caused.
examples.zh: 沒有任何事能挽回那個謠言造成的傷害。

examples.en: The government is trying to lower unemployment among young people.
examples.zh: 政府正努力降低年輕人的失業率。

examples.en: Unemployment rose sharply after the factory closed.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉後，失業人數大幅上升。

examples.en: He received money from the government during his unemployment.
examples.zh: 他在失業期間領取了政府的補助。

examples.en: She unfolded the map and looked for the train station.
examples.zh: 她攤開地圖，尋找火車站。

examples.en: The story unfolds slowly over the first chapter.
examples.zh: 故事在第一章中慢慢展開。

examples.en: We watched the events unfold on the news.
examples.zh: 我們從新聞上看著事情一步步發展。

examples.en: He used a key to unlock the front door.
examples.zh: 他用鑰匙打開了前門。

examples.en: You can unlock your phone with your fingerprint.
examples.zh: 你可以用指紋解鎖手機。

examples.en: Learning English can unlock many new opportunities.
examples.zh: 學英文可以開啟許多新的機會。

examples.en: The city experienced an unprecedented amount of rain this summer.
examples.zh: 這座城市今年夏天經歷了前所未有的雨量。

examples.en: The new phone has sold at an unprecedented speed.
examples.zh: 這款新手機以空前的速度熱賣。

examples.en: The pandemic caused unprecedented changes in how we work.
examples.zh: 疫情為我們的工作方式帶來了史無前例的改變。

examples.en: Please update the software on your phone.
examples.zh: 請更新你手機上的軟體。

examples.en: I'll update you after the meeting ends.
examples.zh: 會議結束後我會向你報告最新情況。

examples.en: The teacher updates the class website every Friday.
examples.zh: 老師每個星期五都會更新班級網站。

examples.en: The app received a major update last week.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式上週有了一次大更新。

examples.en: Here is a quick update on our project.
examples.zh: 以下是我們專案的最新進度。

examples.en: She sent me an update about the flight delay.
examples.zh: 她傳來關於班機延誤的最新消息。
